# mimecast_dmarc_notifications (Data Source)

Read complete typed DMARC Analyzer notification configuration with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dmarc_notifications" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable DMARC notification inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `dmarc_compliance_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the DMARC-compliance trigger is enabled.
- `dmarc_compliance_interval` (String) DMARC-compliance trigger interval.
- `dmarc_compliance_threshold` (Number) DMARC-compliance trigger threshold.
- `dns_dkim_records` (Boolean) Whether the DNS monitor checks DKIM records.
- `dns_dmarc_records` (Boolean) Whether the DNS monitor checks DMARC records.
- `dns_spf_records` (Boolean) Whether the DNS monitor checks SPF records.
- `domains` (Attributes List) Managed domains selected by the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--domains))
- `emails` (Set of String, Sensitive) Notification recipient email addresses.
- `forensic_message_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the forensic-message trigger is enabled.
- `forensic_message_interval` (String) Forensic-message trigger interval.
- `forensic_message_threshold` (Number) Forensic-message trigger threshold.
- `frequency` (String) Notification frequency.
- `groups` (Attributes List) Domain groups selected by the notification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--groups))
- `id` (String) Notification ID.
- `invalid_message_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the invalid-message compliance trigger is enabled.
- `invalid_message_interval` (String) Invalid-message trigger interval.
- `invalid_message_threshold` (Number) Invalid-message trigger threshold.
- `is_individual_domain_alert` (Boolean) Whether compliance alerts are emitted for individual domains.
- `next_trigger` (String) Next scheduled notification trigger timestamp.
- `type` (String) Notification type.

<a id="nestedatt--items--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.domains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Referenced domain name.
- `id` (String) Referenced object ID.
- `name` (String) Referenced object name.


<a id="nestedatt--items--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.groups`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) Referenced domain name.
- `id` (String) Referenced object ID.
- `name` (String) Referenced object name.
